summary: DayBalance backend/frontend regression: 30/31 pytest cases and 50/51 final UI checks passed. Daily source splits, identities, UTC offsets, trapezoid durations/gaps, averages, aliases, exact displayed values/deltas, ratio threshold, chart navigation and polling passed. Historical PV attribution and empty-yesterday handling remain incorrect. No actual public API errors, runtime exceptions or document overflow at 1920x800 / 390x844.

critical.issue: Export source shares are calculated AFTER grouping the whole day/month. Separate 1h of 1000 W PV used locally and 1h of 1000 W battery-only grid export produce self_kwh=0.5 instead of 1.0. Night battery export is falsely attributed to daytime PV. Reproduced against the actual _rows_to_balance function using deterministic totals.

ui_bugs.issue: Repeated console warnings report initial chart width/height=-1 during loads/view changes. Charts subsequently render; no runtime exception or observed persistent clipping. Review initial measurement/container sizing.

integration_issues.flow: Today versus yesterday with no measured yesterday data
integration_issues.issue: The API returns an all-zero object for no snapshots (also for a single snapshot). DayBalance treats it as measured zero and renders '+9,15 kWh ggü. gestern' instead of 'Gestern: –'. Confirmed with a browser-only MOCKED empty-yesterday response matching the real route contract. HTTP-failed yesterday correctly shows 'Gestern: –'.

action_items: Calculate proportional PV/battery export per snapshot or integration interval BEFORE day/month aggregation; preserve source attribution over time. Run the retained failing night-export regression.
Expose measurement availability or measured duration in /api/today, and render unavailable yesterday deltas as 'Gestern: –'. Do not equate genuine measured zero energy with missing snapshots.
Review historical fixed-15-second energy accumulation for consistency with /api/today's timestamp-weighted, gap-skipping integration.
Optional: eliminate transient Recharts negative-dimension warnings and split the 728-line routes.py into focused route modules.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py:99-106 sums PV, charging, discharge and export before routes.py:73-76 computes a nonlinear source fraction. Ratio-of-sums is not equivalent to sum-of-per-sample attribution. This affects both day and month buckets.

routes.py:60-65 still uses a fixed 15-second factor for historical energy, unlike today()'s actual timestamps and >600-second gap skipping. This is a source-review consistency risk; no separate irregular-sampling historical fixture was executed.

routes.py:322-332 returns no availability metadata when snapshots are absent; DayBalance.jsx:99-115 converts this valid-looking object to zeros, so Delta's finite-value guard cannot identify missing measurements.

History.jsx:44-46 silently swallows live/today errors and retains previous state after a failed refresh, without an error/freshness indicator. Initial failed today was tested and correctly displayed '–'; stale-after-success behavior was source-reviewed only.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing hardware readings are DEMO/MOCKED; public APIs and DB are real. Deterministic route tests used isolated in-memory snapshots. UI empty-data, HTTP-502 and charge-threshold responses were explicitly browser-only MOCKED. No DB, config or device-control writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and /verlauf (not /history). Run pytest with exported frontend environment against the three files listed. Retained UI runner executes via namespace={}; exec(compile(open('/app/tests/day_balance_ui_regression.py').read(), 'day_balance_ui_regression.py', 'exec'), namespace); await namespace['run'](page) in the browser tool. Preliminary inline UI harness had five false failures due to Unicode-minus parsing and Python banker rounding; final runner corrects these and all real numeric comparisons pass. A first saved-runner exec attempt lacked explicit namespace and failed before checks. No auth testing required. UI failure injection produced expected console HTTP-502 logs, not actual backend errors. Actual server logs show no route exceptions. Recharts warnings are transient but repeated. Screenshots in screenshots-balance-37. No application source changes made.
rca of the issue: Historical attribution: daytime PV=1 kWh, PV export=0, nighttime battery discharge/export=1 kWh. Whole-day ratio computes PV share=1/(1+1), assigns 0.5 kWh night export to PV, leaving self=0.5. Fix by deriving flows before temporal aggregation. Missing yesterday: no-data response is indistinguishable from measured zero, so valuesFor creates finite zero previous values and Delta computes numerical differences. Add explicit measured-duration/sample availability and suppress unavailable comparisons.
